notes: Idol of Endurance's permission ('you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost') lets Walking Corpse be cast as a spell from hand is: it goes on the stack and the opponent can answer before it resolves (CR 601.2i, 117.3c, 608.1). Cancel counters it, so it goes to its owner's graveyard (CR 701.6a). Ontology round R13: the activation makes a PERMIT; the cast is a menu row through it (cast:<card>:via:<idol>).
